subject: txn: save unnecessary calls to newMemBuffer (#53715)
summary: Caches a single `*memBuffer` wrapper inside `tikvTxn` so `GetMemBuffer()` no longer allocates/wraps repeatedly; `newMemBuffer` now returns `*memBuffer` to support that caching. Checked surrounding txn + pipelined-memdb behavior and later history up to `upstream/master`; no correctness/data-consistency regressions or follow-up fixes observed for this change.
